meta.title: Fix infinite loop caused by empty regex in minimap section header detection
meta.body_summary: Fix infinite loop in VS Code minimap section header detection when editor.minimap.markSectionHeaderRegex is empty string, by adding early return and existing regExpLeadsToEndlessLoop check.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot fixed infinite loop from empty regex with early return and regExpLeadsToEndlessLoop check; 4 approvals, merged quickly, no performance evidence required beyond tests.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 45 changed lines (all additions), this is a tiny, targeted fix by absolute volume. It fits a small-step preventive performance bugfix PR that was merged quickly with no resistance.

review_details.concern_detail: No review comments or inline feedback were recorded; all four formal reviews were APPROVED with empty bodies.
review_details.performance_claim: Prevents 100% CPU usage caused by infinite loop when editor.minimap.markSectionHeaderRegex is set to an empty string.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Infinite loop fix in editor minimap required understanding of regex.lastIndex behavior and existing utility functions; the agent succeeded within a narrow technical scope.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainers approved the PR without written feedback; the fix was presumably verified through reading the diff and the linked issue reproduction.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The PR body describes the infinite loop logically and adds unit tests for empty regex cases, but no before/after timing or reproduction steps for end users.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression was reported; the fix was immediately approved and merged without further iteration.

core_change_summary.description: In findSectionHeaders.ts, collectMarkHeaders now returns early for empty/whitespace regex and also checks regExpLeadsToEndlessLoop before entering the while loop; findSectionHeaders.test.ts adds test cases for empty string, whitespace, and valid regex.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test file adds 34 lines covering the new defensive checks.
change_trajectory: Initial plan commit for linked issue.
Main commit adds early return for empty regex and endless loop check, plus corresponding unit tests.
